summary.headline: Sentra is the autonomous crisis intelligence operating system for the physical world.
summary.subheadline: AI command, digital twins, operations automation, security trust, and executive proof in one global resilience platform.
summary.positioning: Category-defining command OS for hotels, hospitals, campuses, malls, enterprises, and smart cities.

product_overview.title: Crisis Intelligence
product_overview.body: AI predicts hazards, human behavior, resource pressure, and executive impact before chaos compounds.

product_overview.title: Digital Twin
product_overview.body: Live facility, campus, responder, hazard, replay, and predictive overlays make the invisible operationally obvious.

product_overview.title: AI Council
product_overview.body: Specialist agents debate strategy, expose tradeoffs, and produce governed recommendations.

product_overview.title: Operations Automation
product_overview.body: Sentra dispatches teams, routes approvals, sends alerts, tracks SLAs, and drives recovery.

product_overview.title: Global Command
product_overview.body: Multi-tenant cloud, partner channels, marketplace integrations, and board intelligence scale the platform worldwide.

outcomes.label: Reduce response time
outcomes.proof: Workflow execution, communications, and resource dispatch remove manual delay.

outcomes.label: Reduce losses
outcomes.proof: Recovery continuity, digital twin replay, and audit evidence compress downtime.

outcomes.proof: Self-healing operations, zero trust, and compliance readiness strengthen continuity.

social_proof.quote: Sentra turns every property into a coordinated command center.
The human behavior layer is the missing bridge between alerts and safe movement.
This is the operating layer a resilient city needs.

story.title: The world is fragmented
story.body: Crises unfold across sensors, radios, apps, people, and leadership rooms that rarely agree fast enough.

story.title: Risk is increasing
story.body: Climate shocks, cyber-physical incidents, dense venues, and fragile infrastructure raise the cost of delay.

story.title: Current tools fail
story.body: Dashboards show alerts but do not coordinate human movement, responders, approvals, recovery, and executives.

story.title: Sentra unifies signals
story.body: AI, IoT, digital twins, communications, operations, security, and data become one command organism.

story.title: AI predicts and acts
story.body: Sentra forecasts hazards, crowd behavior, resource pressure, and business impact, then executes governed workflows.

story.title: Institutions win
story.body: Hospitals, hotels, campuses, malls, governments, and smart cities recover faster with auditable proof.

story.title: A global future is secured
story.body: Every incident becomes intelligence, and every deployment strengthens the resilience graph.
